svg.aria-label: What make capstone reported on 19 November 2026: 6 of 6 reconciliations OK, counts and checksums matching between MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j and Redis and the lake; 11,463 payment events in source and lake; raw lake unchanged after the re-run and the March backfill; pipeline run time 7.4 s, 71.9 s including starting the 4 containers.
